+
+def _write_pose(asset, pose, env_ids, origins):
+    dev, n = origins.device, len(env_ids)
+    p = torch.tensor(pose, device=dev, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0).repeat(n, 1)
+    p[:, :3] += origins[env_ids]
+    asset.write_root_pose_to_sim(p, env_ids=env_ids)
+    asset.write_root_velocity_to_sim(torch.zeros(n, 6, device=dev), env_ids=env_ids)
+
+
+class _TaskState:
+    def __init__(self, env: ManagerBasedEnv, task: "AirLockoutTask"):
+        n, dev = env.num_envs, env.device
+        self.manifold = env.scene[MANIFOLD]
+        self.hose_t = env.scene[HOSE_T]
+        self.hose_d = env.scene[HOSE_D]
+        self.box = env.scene[LOCKOUT]
+        self.lock = env.scene[PADLOCK]
+        self.robot = env.scene["robot"]
+        self.plug_t = self.hose_t.find_bodies("plug")[0][0]
+        self.plug_d = self.hose_d.find_bodies("plug")[0][0]
+        self.pull_link = self.hose_t.find_bodies(f"cord_{PULL_LINK:02d}")[0][0]
+        self.sleeve_joints = self.manifold.find_joints("sleeve_.*_joint")[0]
+        self.sleeve_t = self.manifold.find_joints("sleeve_target_joint")[0][0]
+        self.sleeve_d = self.manifold.find_joints("sleeve_decoy_joint")[0][0]
+        self.ball_joints = self.manifold.find_joints("ball_.*_joint")[0]
+        self.hinge = self.box.find_joints("hinge")[0][0]
+        self.base_id = self.box.find_bodies("base")[0][0]
+        self.lid_id = self.box.find_bodies("lid")[0][0]
+        self.shackle_joint = self.lock.find_joints("shackle_joint")[0][0]
+        self.lock_body = self.lock.find_bodies("body")[0][0]
+        self.shackle_id = self.lock.find_bodies("shackle")[0][0]
+        self.flange_ids, _ = self.robot.find_bodies(["left_gripper", "right_gripper"], preserve_order=True)
+        self.scorer = AirLockoutScorer(n, dev)
+        self.next_layout = make_seed(task.default_seed)
+        self.layouts: dict[int, Layout] = {}
+        self.last_reports: dict[int, dict] = {}
+        self.plug_pts = torch.tensor(props.PLUG_POINTS, device=dev)
+        self.seat_t = torch.tensor(seat("target"), device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)
+        self.seat_d = torch.tensor(seat("decoy"), device=dev, dtype=torch.float32)
+        zb = lambda: torch.zeros(n, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)  # noqa: E731
+        zl = lambda: torch.zeros(n, dtype=torch.long, device=dev)  # noqa: E731
+        zf = lambda: torch.zeros(n, device=dev)  # noqa: E731
+        self.latched, self.latched_through, self.released, self.force_test = zb(), zb(), zb(), zb()
+        self.pry_held, self.pull_held, self.test_passed, self.closed_in_once = zb(), zb(), zb(), zb()
+        self.clear_steps, self.phase, self.phase_steps = zl(), zl(), zl()
+        self.pry_max, self.decoy_max, self.s_t, self.s_d, self.hinge_deg = zf(), zf(), zf(), zf(), zf()
+        self.sleeve_t_max, self.sleeve_d_max = zf(), zf()
+        self.wait_steps = max(1, round(TEST_WAIT_S / env.step_dt))
+        self.phase_len = max(1, round(TEST_PHASE_S / env.step_dt))
+        self.ramp_len = max(1, round(PRY_RAMP_S / env.step_dt))
+
+
+def through_tab(tip, top, tab_y, half_t):
+    """The short leg (tip -> top, in a shell's frame) crosses that shell's tab (mid-plane y = tab_y) inside its hole."""
+    denom = tip[:, 1] - top[:, 1]
+    denom = torch.where(denom.abs() > 1e-6, denom, torch.full_like(denom, 1e-6))
+    a = ((tip[:, 1] - tab_y) / denom).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
+    cross = tip + a.unsqueeze(1) * (top - tip)
+    h = props.TAB_HOLE / 2
+    in_hole = ((cross[:, 0] - props.TAB_HOLE_X).abs() < h) & (cross[:, 2].abs() < h)
+    spans = (((tip[:, 1] < tab_y - half_t) & (top[:, 1] > tab_y + half_t))
+             | ((tip[:, 1] > tab_y + half_t) & (top[:, 1] < tab_y - half_t)))
+    return in_hole & spans
+
+
+class AirLockoutTask(TaskBase):
+    def __init__(self, default_seed: int = 0, episode_length_s: float = 180.0):
+        super().__init__(episode_length_s=episode_length_s, task_description=make_seed(default_seed).instruction)
+        self.default_seed = default_seed
+
+    def state(self, env: ManagerBasedEnv) -> _TaskState:
+        if getattr(env, "_task_state", None) is None:
+            env._task_state = _TaskState(env, self)
+        return env._task_state
+
+    def force_function_test(self, env: ManagerBasedEnv) -> None:
+        """Control runs: start the check now, padlock or not."""
+        self.state(env).force_test[:] = True
+
+    def episode_report(self, env: ManagerBasedEnv, env_id: int = 0, ended: bool = False) -> dict:
+        st = self.state(env)
+        if ended and env_id in st.last_reports:
+            return st.last_reports.pop(env_id)
+        return self._report(st, env_id)
+
+    def _report(self, st: _TaskState, env_id: int) -> dict:
+        r = st.scorer.report(env_id)
+        r.update(
+            target_out_mm=round(float(st.s_t[env_id]) * 1000, 1), decoy_out_max_mm=round(float(st.decoy_max[env_id]) * 1000, 2),
+            target_sleeve_max_mm=round(float(st.sleeve_t_max[env_id]) * 1000, 1),
+            decoy_sleeve_max_mm=round(float(st.sleeve_d_max[env_id]) * 1000, 1),
+            hinge_deg=round(float(st.hinge_deg[env_id]), 1), closed_on_plug=bool(st.closed_in_once[env_id]),
+            shackle_latched=bool(st.latched[env_id]), latched_through_tabs=bool(st.latched_through[env_id]),
+            released=bool(st.released[env_id]), check_phase=int(st.phase[env_id]),
+            pry_max_deg=round(math.degrees(float(st.pry_max[env_id])), 1), pry_held=bool(st.pry_held[env_id]),
+            pull_held=bool(st.pull_held[env_id]), check_passed=bool(st.test_passed[env_id]),
+        )
+        if hasattr(st, "in_excess"):
+            r.update(plug_in_lockout=bool(st.inside_now[env_id]),
+                     plug_out_of_shell_mm=[round(float(v) * 1000, 1) for v in st.in_excess[env_id]])
+        return r
+
+    def get_scene_cfg(self):
+        return None
+
+    def get_events_cfg(self):
+        return EventsCfg(self)
+
+    def get_termination_cfg(self) -> TaskTerminationCfg:
+        sequence = [(self._milestone_predicate(m), 0.25) for m in MILESTONES]
+        return TaskTerminationCfg(timeout_s=self.episode_length_s,
+                                  success=[CompletionCriteria(name="milestones", predicate_sequence=sequence)])
+
+    def get_mimic_env_cfg(self, arm_mode: ArmMode):
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def get_metrics(self) -> list[MetricBase]:
+        return [SuccessRateMetric()]
+
+    def _milestone_predicate(self, milestone: int):
+        def predicate(env: ManagerBasedEnv) -> torch.Tensor:
+            return self.state(env).scorer.milestone >= milestone
+
+        predicate.__name__ = f"milestone_{milestone}"
+        return predicate
+
+    # Events ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+    def reset(self, env: ManagerBasedEnv, env_ids: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        st = self.state(env)
+        reset_robot_home(env, env_ids)
+        for env_id in env_ids.tolist():
+            if int(st.scorer.step[env_id]) > 0:
+                st.last_reports[env_id] = self._report(st, env_id)
+        layout = st.next_layout
+        dev, n = env.device, len(env_ids)
+        origins = env.scene.env_origins
+        st.scorer.reset(env_ids)
+        for buf in (st.latched, st.latched_through, st.released, st.force_test, st.pry_held, st.pull_held,
+                    st.test_passed, st.closed_in_once):
+            buf[env_ids] = False
+        for buf in (st.clear_steps, st.phase, st.phase_steps):
+            buf[env_ids] = 0
+        for buf in (st.pry_max, st.decoy_max, st.sleeve_t_max, st.sleeve_d_max):
+            buf[env_ids] = 0.0
+        for asset in (st.box, st.hose_t, st.lock):
+            asset.permanent_wrench_composer.reset(env_ids=env_ids)
+        # Couplers: sleeves forward on their preloaded springs, balls in the grooves.
+        zj = torch.zeros(n, st.manifold.num_joints, device=dev)
+        st.manifold.write_joint_state_to_sim(zj, zj, env_ids=env_ids)
+        st.manifold.set_joint_position_target(zj, env_ids=env_ids)
+        ns = len(st.sleeve_joints)
+        st.manifold.set_joint_position_target(torch.full((n, ns), -props.SLEEVE_PRELOAD, device=dev),
+                                              joint_ids=st.sleeve_joints, env_ids=env_ids)
+        for hose in (st.hose_t, st.hose_d):
+            zh = torch.zeros(n, hose.num_joints, device=dev)
+            hose.write_joint_state_to_sim(zh, zh, env_ids=env_ids)
+            hose.set_joint_position_target(zh, env_ids=env_ids)
+        # Lockout open against its stop.
+        h = torch.full((n, 1), LID_OPEN_RAD, device=dev)
+        st.box.write_joint_state_to_sim(h, torch.zeros_like(h), joint_ids=[st.hinge], env_ids=env_ids)
+        st.box.set_joint_position_target(h, joint_ids=[st.hinge], env_ids=env_ids)
+        # Padlock open on its pedestal.
+        joint = [st.shackle_joint]
+        limits = torch.tensor([[[0.0, lock_props.OPEN_TRAVEL]]], device=dev).expand(n, 1, 2).contiguous()
+        travel = torch.full((n, 1), lock_props.OPEN_TRAVEL, device=dev)
+        st.lock.write_joint_position_limit_to_sim(limits, joint_ids=joint, env_ids=env_ids, warn_limit_violation=False)
+        st.lock.write_joint_state_to_sim(travel, torch.zeros_like(travel), joint_ids=joint, env_ids=env_ids)
+        st.lock.set_joint_position_target(travel + 0.005, joint_ids=joint, env_ids=env_ids)
+        _write_pose(st.lock, lock_start_pose(), env_ids, origins)
+        for env_id in env_ids.tolist():
+            st.layouts[env_id] = layout
+
+    def box_frame(self, st: _TaskState, origins: torch.Tensor):
+        n, dev = origins.shape[0], origins.device
+        bquat = st.box.data.body_quat_w.torch[:, st.base_id]
+        bpos = (st.box.data.body_pos_w.torch[:, st.base_id] - origins
+                + math_utils.quat_apply(bquat, torch.tensor([props.BOX_CENTER], device=dev).expand(n, 3)))
+        return bpos, bquat
+
+    def step(self, env: ManagerBasedEnv, env_ids: torch.Tensor) -> None:  # noqa: C901
+        st = self.state(env)
+        origins = env.scene.env_origins
+        n, dev = env.num_envs, env.device
+        live = st.phase == 0
+
+        # Plugs and sleeves.
+        pt = st.hose_t.data.body_pos_w.torch[:, st.plug_t] - origins
+        qt = st.hose_t.data.body_quat_w.torch[:, st.plug_t]
+        pd = st.hose_d.data.body_pos_w.torch[:, st.plug_d] - origins
+        st.s_t = (pt - st.seat_t).norm(dim=1)
+        st.s_d = (pd - st.seat_d).norm(dim=1)
+        st.decoy_max = torch.where(live, torch.maximum(st.decoy_max, st.s_d), st.decoy_max)
+        sj = st.manifold.data.joint_pos.torch
+        st.sleeve_t_max = torch.maximum(st.sleeve_t_max, sj[:, st.sleeve_t])
+        st.sleeve_d_max = torch.maximum(st.sleeve_d_max, sj[:, st.sleeve_d])
+        unplugged = st.s_t > UNPLUGGED_M
+
+        # The plug in the lockout (lower half fixed: its frame is the box frame).
+        bpos, bquat = self.box_frame(st, origins)
+        npt = st.plug_pts.shape[0]
+        corners = pt[:, None] + math_utils.quat_apply(qt[:, None].expand(n, npt, 4).reshape(-1, 4),
+                                                      st.plug_pts[None].expand(n, npt, 3).reshape(-1, 3)).reshape(n, npt, 3)
+        local = math_utils.quat_apply_inverse(bquat[:, None].expand(n, npt, 4).reshape(-1, 4),
+                                              (corners - bpos[:, None]).reshape(-1, 3)).reshape(n, npt, 3)
+        inside = torch.ones(n, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
+        excess = []
+        for k, (lo, hi) in enumerate(props.INTERIOR):
+            inside &= ((local[..., k] > lo - IN_TOL_M) & (local[..., k] < hi + IN_TOL_M)).all(dim=1)
+            excess.append(torch.maximum(lo - local[..., k], local[..., k] - hi).amax(dim=1))
+        st.in_excess = torch.stack(excess, dim=1)
+        st.inside_now = inside
+        hinge = st.box.data.joint_pos.torch[:, st.hinge]
+        st.hinge_deg = torch.rad2deg(hinge)
+        closed = hinge < math.radians(CLOSED_DEG)
+        closed_in = closed & inside
+        st.closed_in_once |= closed_in & live
+
+        # Padlock: the short leg through both tabs (each in its own shell's frame).
+        travel = st.lock.data.joint_pos.torch[:, st.shackle_joint]
+        lock_pos = st.lock.data.body_pos_w.torch[:, st.lock_body] - origins
+        sh_pos = st.lock.data.body_pos_w.torch[:, st.shackle_id] - origins
+        sh_quat = st.lock.data.body_quat_w.torch[:, st.shackle_id]
+        lpos = st.box.data.body_pos_w.torch[:, st.lid_id] - origins
+        lquat = st.box.data.body_quat_w.torch[:, st.lid_id]
+
+        def on_shackle(p):
+            return sh_pos + math_utils.quat_apply(sh_quat, torch.tensor([p], device=dev).expand(n, 3))
+
+        tip_w = on_shackle((PV.leg_x, 0.0, lock_props.SHORT_LEG_BOTTOM))
+        top_w = on_shackle((PV.leg_x, 0.0, PV.bend_z - PV.rod / 2))
+        half_t = props.TAB_T / 2
+        tab_y = props.TAB_GAP + props.TAB_T / 2

+  sleeve, about 50 mm long and 23.6 mm across the sleeve. Inside, a ring of steel balls sits in holes in the body's
+  bore; the spring-loaded sleeve's inner land holds them in the plug's groove, so the plug cannot come out. Pulling
+  the sleeve back (toward the air supply) brings a relief over the balls; they can then move outward and the plug's
+  lip pushes past them.
+- Plug: M-style male plug with a 1/4 in hose barb (about 45 mm long, 14.3 mm hex), on a 1/4 in ID air hose
+  (9.5 mm across) with a crimped ferrule. The nipple's lip, groove and shoulder are inferred proportions (the
+  interchange drawing is not public); collision is square, not round.

+  7.87 mm, 20 mm clearance; hose/cord hole up to 9.4 mm): two half-shells hinged along one long edge; a hole at
+  one end split between the halves takes the hose; one flat tab per half at the middle of the front, side by side,
+  their holes lined up when the lid is shut.
+

+tapered holes) and at the sleeve's land (outer); with the sleeve forward the balls stand 1.1 mm inside the lip's
+radius, so the lip cannot pass; with the sleeve back by 5 mm the land has passed the balls and they rise clear.
+How the lockout holds (geometry): the plug's hex and ferrule (14-15 mm) cannot pass the 10 mm hose hole; the
+nipple is inside the closed shell, so it cannot be connected; a shackle through both tabs' holes stops the lid

+    mesh.CreatePointsAttr(Vt.Vec3fArray([Gf.Vec3f(*[float(v) for v in p]) for p in pts]))
+    mesh.CreateFaceVertexCountsAttr(Vt.IntArray(counts))
+    mesh.CreateFaceVertexIndicesAttr(Vt.IntArray(faces))
+    mesh.CreateSubdivisionSchemeAttr("none")
+    mesh.CreateDoubleSidedAttr(True)
+    UsdShade.MaterialBindingAPI.Apply(mesh.GetPrim()).Bind(material)
+    return mesh
+
+
+def _box(stage, path, x, y, z, mat, collide=True):
+    c = ((x[0] + x[1]) / 2, (y[0] + y[1]) / 2, (z[0] + z[1]) / 2)
+    s = (x[1] - x[0], y[1] - y[0], z[1] - z[0])
+    return kit.box(stage, path, c, s, mat, collide=collide)
+
+
+def _body(stage, path, pos, rot, mass, inertia=None):
+    xform = UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, path)
+    xform.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(*[float(v) for v in pos]))
+    x, y, z, w = _mat_q(rot)
+    xform.AddOrientOp().Set(Gf.Quatf(float(w), float(x), float(y), float(z)))
+    UsdPhysics.RigidBodyAPI.Apply(xform.GetPrim())
+    mass_api = UsdPhysics.MassAPI.Apply(xform.GetPrim())
+    mass_api.CreateMassAttr(mass)
+    if inertia is not None:
+        com, diag = inertia
+        mass_api.CreateCenterOfMassAttr(Gf.Vec3f(*com))
+        mass_api.CreateDiagonalInertiaAttr(Gf.Vec3f(*diag))
+        mass_api.CreatePrincipalAxesAttr(Gf.Quatf(1, 0, 0, 0))
+    return xform
+
+
+def _sphere(stage, path, radius, material):
+    sph = UsdGeom.Sphere.Define(stage, path)
+    sph.CreateRadiusAttr(radius)
+    UsdShade.MaterialBindingAPI.Apply(sph.GetPrim()).Bind(material)
+    UsdPhysics.CollisionAPI.Apply(sph.GetPrim())
+    return sph
+
+
+def _offsets(stage) -> None:
+    for prim in stage.Traverse():
+        if prim.HasAPI(UsdPhysics.CollisionAPI):
+            prim.AddAppliedSchema("PhysxCollisionAPI")
+            prim.CreateAttribute("physxCollision:contactOffset", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Float).Set(CONTACT_OFFSET)
+            prim.CreateAttribute("physxCollision:restOffset", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Float).Set(0.0)
+
+
+def _solver(root_prim) -> None:
+    root_prim.CreateAttribute("physxArticulation:solverPositionIterationCount", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Int).Set(
+        SOLVER_ITERATIONS)
+    root_prim.CreateAttribute("physxArticulation:solverVelocityIterationCount", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Int).Set(4)
+
+
+def _joint(stage, path, kind, body0, frame0, body1, frame1, world_point, world_rot, axis, lower, upper):
+    joint = (UsdPhysics.RevoluteJoint if kind == "revolute" else UsdPhysics.PrismaticJoint).Define(stage, path)
+    joint.CreateBody0Rel().SetTargets([Sdf.Path(str(body0))])
+    joint.CreateBody1Rel().SetTargets([Sdf.Path(str(body1))])
+    joint.CreateAxisAttr(axis)
+    for (p, r), pos_attr, rot_attr in ((frame0, joint.CreateLocalPos0Attr, joint.CreateLocalRot0Attr),
+                                       (frame1, joint.CreateLocalPos1Attr, joint.CreateLocalRot1Attr)):
+        pos_attr(Gf.Vec3f(*[float(v) for v in r.T @ (np.asarray(world_point) - p)]))
+        x, y, z, w = _mat_q(r.T @ world_rot)
+        rot_attr(Gf.Quatf(float(w), float(x), float(y), float(z)))
+    joint.CreateLowerLimitAttr(lower)
+    joint.CreateUpperLimitAttr(upper)
+    UsdPhysics.DriveAPI.Apply(joint.GetPrim(), "angular" if kind == "revolute" else "linear")
+    return joint
+
+
+class _Frame:
+    """Authoring in a local frame (position p, rotation r) under a body whose own frame is (bp, br)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, stage, body_path, body_frame, p, r):
+        self.stage, self.body_path = stage, body_path
+        bp, br = body_frame
+        self.p = br.T @ (np.asarray(p) - bp)
+        self.r = br.T @ r
+
+    def xform(self, name):
+        xf = UsdGeom.Xform.Define(self.stage, f"{self.body_path}/{name}")
+        xf.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(*[float(v) for v in self.p]))
+        x, y, z, w = _mat_q(self.r)
+        xf.AddOrientOp().Set(Gf.Quatf(float(w), float(x), float(y), float(z)))
+        return f"{self.body_path}/{name}"
+

+# Manifold and couplers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+def ball_dirs():
+    """The four balls' radial directions in the coupler frame (they face the square nipple's four flats)."""
+    return [np.array(v, dtype=float) for v in ((0, 0, 1), (0, 1, 0), (0, 0, -1), (0, -1, 0))]
+
+
+def _coupler_body(stage, base, which, mats):
+    """A coupler's fixed parts on the manifold's base link (coupler frame = mouth, R_C): the bore walls, the plug
+    stop and the visual brass body. Returns collider paths."""
+    f = _Frame(stage, base, (np.zeros(3), np.eye(3)), coupler_root(which), R_C)
+    c = f.xform(f"coupler_{which}")
+    cols = []
+    h, t = BORE_HW, BORE_T
+    for k, (y, z) in enumerate([((-h - t, h + t), (h, h + t)), ((-h - t, h + t), (-h - t, -h)),
+                                ((h, h + t), (-h, h)), ((-h - t, -h), (-h, h))]):
+        cols.append(_box(stage, f"{c}/bore_{k}", (0.0005, BODY_L), y, z, mats["brass"]))
+    cols.append(_box(stage, f"{c}/stop", (SEAT_X, SEAT_X + 0.004), (-h, h), (-h, h), mats["dark"]))
+    # Visual: the body under the sleeve, its hex at the back, the dark bore.
+    kit.cylinder(stage, f"{c}/body_vis", (BODY_L / 2 + 0.006, 0, 0), 9.6 * MM, BODY_L - 0.012, mats["brass"], axis="X")
+    _hex_prism(stage, f"{c}/hex", BODY_L - 0.013, BODY_L, 0.022, mats["brass"])
+    kit.cylinder(stage, f"{c}/bore_vis", (0.004, 0, 0), BORE_HW + 0.0002, 0.0075, mats["dark"], axis="X")
+    return cols
+
+
+def _sleeve(stage, root, base, which, mats):
+    """The sleeve: a body at the mouth (coupler frame) on a prismatic joint along the coupler's axis. Colliders: the
+    inner land over the balls and the outer shell (square, 23.6 mm across flats, where fingers hold it)."""
+    p = coupler_root(which)
+    body = _body(stage, f"{root}/sleeve_{which}", p, R_C, SLEEVE_MASS)
+    s = f"{root}/sleeve_{which}"
+    cols = []
+    w = (-3.2 * MM, 3.2 * MM)
+    for k, d in enumerate(ball_dirs()):
+        lo, hi = LAND_R, LAND_R + 0.0015
+        span = (lo, hi) if d.sum() > 0 else (-hi, -lo)
+        y, z = (w, span) if abs(d[2]) > 0.5 else (span, w)
+        cols.append(_box(stage, f"{s}/land_{k}", LAND_X, y, z, mats["brass"]))
+    R, T = SLEEVE_R, SLEEVE_T
+    for k, (y, z) in enumerate([((-R, R), (R - T, R)), ((-R, R), (-R, -R + T)), ((R - T, R), (-R + T, R - T)),
+                                ((-R, -R + T), (-R + T, R - T))]):
+        cols.append(_box(stage, f"{s}/shell_{k}", (0.0, SLEEVE_L), y, z, mats["brass"]))
+        kit.hide(stage, f"{s}/shell_{k}")
+    # Visual: knurled brass sleeve (a cylinder with dark rings) and its front face ring.
+    kit.cylinder(stage, f"{s}/vis", (SLEEVE_L / 2, 0, 0), R, SLEEVE_L, mats["brass"], axis="X")
+    for j in range(5):
+        kit.cylinder(stage, f"{s}/knurl_{j}", (0.010 + 0.0028 * j, 0, 0), R + 0.0003, 0.0008, mats["zinc"], axis="X")
+    _joint(stage, f"{root}/joints/sleeve_{which}_joint", "prismatic", base, (np.zeros(3), np.eye(3)), body.GetPath(),
+           (p, R_C), p, R_C, "X", 0.0, SLEEVE_TRAVEL)
+    return cols
+
+
+def _balls(stage, root, base, which, mats):
+    cols = []
+    origin = coupler_root(which)
+    for k, d in enumerate(ball_dirs()):
+        dw = R_C @ d
+        p = origin + R_C @ np.array([BALL_X, 0, 0]) + BALL_R_IN * dw
+        # Joint frame: x along the ball's outward direction.
+        xr = dw
+        yr = R_C @ np.array([1.0, 0, 0])
+        zr = np.cross(xr, yr)
+        r = np.stack([xr, yr, zr], axis=1)
+        body = _body(stage, f"{root}/ball_{which}_{k}", p, r, BALL_MASS,
+                     ((0, 0, 0), (2e-9, 2e-9, 2e-9)))
+        cols.append(str(_sphere(stage, f"{root}/ball_{which}_{k}/ball", BALL_R, mats["steel"]).GetPath()))
+        _joint(stage, f"{root}/joints/ball_{which}_{k}_joint", "prismatic", base, (np.zeros(3), np.eye(3)),
+               body.GetPath(), (p, r), p, r, "X", 0.0, BALL_TRAVEL)
+    return cols
+
+
+def make_manifold(out_path: Path) -> None:
+    root = "/manifold"
+    stage, root_prim = kit.new_stage(out_path, root)
+    kit.articulation_root(stage, root_prim, self_collisions=True)
+    _solver(root_prim)
+    mats = _mats(stage, root)
+    base = _body(stage, f"{root}/base", (0.0, 0.0, 0.0), np.eye(3), 3.0)
+    b = f"{root}/base"
+    # Manifold block on a post with a foot plate, a supply line with a ball valve (handle across = shut).
+    _box(stage, f"{b}/block", MANIFOLD_X, MANIFOLD_Y, MANIFOLD_Z, mats["alu"])
+    px = (sum(MANIFOLD_X) / 2 - 0.02, sum(MANIFOLD_X) / 2 + 0.02)
+    _box(stage, f"{b}/post", px, MANIFOLD_Y, (TABLE_Z, MANIFOLD_Z[0]), mats["stand"])
+    _box(stage, f"{b}/foot", (px[0] - 0.04, px[1] + 0.04), (MANIFOLD_Y[0] - 0.02, MANIFOLD_Y[1] + 0.03),
+         (TABLE_Z, TABLE_Z + 0.006), mats["stand"])
+    yc, zc = sum(MANIFOLD_Y) / 2, COUPLER_Z
+    kit.cylinder(stage, f"{b}/supply_nipple", (MANIFOLD_X[1] + 0.012, yc, zc), 0.0065, 0.024, mats["brass"], axis="X")
+    _box(stage, f"{b}/valve", (MANIFOLD_X[1] + 0.024, MANIFOLD_X[1] + 0.054), (yc - 0.013, yc + 0.013),
+         (zc - 0.013, zc + 0.013), mats["brass"], collide=False)
+    _box(stage, f"{b}/valve_stem", (MANIFOLD_X[1] + 0.036, MANIFOLD_X[1] + 0.042), (yc - 0.003, yc + 0.003),
+         (zc + 0.013, zc + 0.020), mats["steel"], collide=False)
+    _box(stage, f"{b}/valve_handle", (MANIFOLD_X[1] + 0.033, MANIFOLD_X[1] + 0.045), (yc - 0.06, yc + 0.004),
+         (zc + 0.020, zc + 0.024), mats["valve_red"], collide=False)
+    kit.cylinder(stage, f"{b}/supply_hose", (MANIFOLD_X[1] + 0.104, yc, zc), 0.0075, 0.10, mats["dark"], axis="X")
+    cols = []
+    for which in ("target", "decoy"):
+        cols += _coupler_body(stage, b, which, mats)
+        p = coupler_root(which)
+        # The coupler's threaded nipple into the manifold (visual).
+        kit.cylinder(stage, f"{b}/nipple_{which}", (p[0], MOUTH_Y + BODY_L + NIPPLE_L / 2, p[2]), 0.0065,
+                     NIPPLE_L + 0.002, mats["brass"], axis="Y")
+        _box(stage, f"{b}/nipple_hex_{which}", (p[0] - 0.0079, p[0] + 0.0079), (MOUTH_Y + BODY_L + 0.010,
+             MOUTH_Y + BODY_L + 0.018), (p[2] - 0.0079, p[2] + 0.0079), mats["brass"], collide=False)
+    for which in ("target", "decoy"):
+        cols += _sleeve(stage, root, base.GetPath(), which, mats)
+        cols += _balls(stage, root, base.GetPath(), which, mats)
+    kit.fix_to_world(stage, root, base.GetPath())
+    kit.friction(stage, root, [str(c.GetPath()) if hasattr(c, "GetPath") else c for c in cols],
+                 static=BRASS_FRICTION, dynamic=BRASS_FRICTION, name="brass", combine="min")
+    shells = [f"{root}/sleeve_{w}/shell_{k}" for w in ("target", "decoy") for k in range(4)]
+    kit.friction(stage, root, shells, static=1.2, dynamic=1.0, name="sleeve_grip", combine="max")
+    _offsets(stage)
+    stage.GetRootLayer().Save()
+    print(f"wrote {out_path}")
+
+
+# Hoses and plugs -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+ANCHOR_HEADING_DEG = {"target": 70.0, "decoy": 85.0}
+TAIL = np.array([-PLUG_L, 0.0, 0.0])
+
+
+def anchor(which: str):
+    x, y = ANCHOR_XY[which]
+    return np.array([x, y, TABLE_Z + CORD_R]), _rot("Z", math.radians(ANCHOR_HEADING_DEG[which]))
+
+
+def joint_axis(k: int) -> str:
+    return AXES[k % len(AXES)]
+
+
+def cord_fk(which: str, q):
+    """Frames (pos, rot) of the CORD_N links and of the plug for joint angles q (CORD_N + 1 of them)."""
+    p, r = anchor(which)
+    p, r = p.copy(), r.copy()
+    links = []
+    for k in range(CORD_N):
+        r = r @ _rot(joint_axis(k), q[k])
+        links.append((p.copy(), r.copy()))
+        p = p + r @ np.array([CORD_LINK, 0, 0])
+    r = r @ _rot(joint_axis(CORD_N), q[CORD_N])
+    return links, (p - r @ TAIL, r)
+
+
+def plug_start(which: str):
+    return coupler_root(which) + R_C @ np.array([SEAT_X, 0, 0]), R_C.copy()
+
+
+def _points(links):
+    pts = []
+    for p, r in links:
+        pts += [p + r @ np.array([f * CORD_LINK, 0, 0]) for f in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0)]
+    return pts
+
+
+def solve_route(which: str, avoid=(), verbose=True):
+    """Joint angles that route the hose from its clamp along the table, up to its plug in the coupler. The hose leaves
+    the plug heading to the robot's right, stays off the other hose, the manifold and the arm base, and keeps out of
+    the space above the plug where the hand comes down."""
+    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
+    from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+
+    sp, sr = plug_start(which)
+    floor = TABLE_Z + CORD_R + 0.0003
+    other = "decoy" if which == "target" else "target"
+    op = coupler_root(other)
+    lo = np.array([op[0] - 0.012, op[1] - PLUG_L - 0.002, op[2] - 0.012])
+    hi = np.array([op[0] + 0.012, op[1] + 0.06, op[2] + 0.012])
+    avoid = np.asarray(avoid).reshape(-1, 3) if len(avoid) else np.zeros((0, 3))
+    tp = coupler_root(which)
+
+    def residual(q):
+        links, (pos, rot) = cord_fk(which, q)
+        err_p = (pos - sp) * 3000.0
+        err_r = Rotation.from_matrix(sr.T @ rot).as_rotvec() * 300.0
+        P = np.asarray(_points(links))
+        pen = [np.maximum(0.0, floor - P[:, 2]) * 300.0, 3.0 * (P[:-20, 2] - floor)]
+        E = P[:-2]
+        d = np.minimum(E - lo, hi - E).min(axis=1) + 0.006 + CORD_R
+        pen.append(np.maximum(0.0, d) * 400.0)
+        # Off the manifold and its post, off the right arm's base.
+        pen.append(np.maximum(0.0, E[:, 1] - (MOUTH_Y - 0.004)) * 300.0)
+        pen.append(np.maximum(0.0, 0.12 - np.hypot(E[:, 0], E[:, 1] + 0.305)) * 300.0)
+        # The hands' way down to the plug: keep the first 12 cm from the plug low (below the coupler's axis).
+        box = (np.abs(E[:, 0] - tp[0]) < 0.05) & (E[:, 1] > tp[1] - 0.12)
+        pen.append(np.maximum(0.0, E[:, 2] - (tp[2] + 0.004)) * 300.0 * box)
+        if len(avoid):
+            dd = np.linalg.norm(P[:, None] - avoid[None], axis=2).min(axis=1)
+            pen.append(np.maximum(0.0, 2 * CORD_R + 0.006 - dd) * 400.0)
+        relief = 3.0 * np.asarray(q[-RELIEF_JOINTS:])
+        return np.concatenate([err_p, err_r, 0.1 * np.asarray(q), relief, *pen])
+
+    lim = math.radians(CORD_LIMIT_DEG) * 0.8
+    best = None
+    for trial in range(6):
+        q0 = np.random.default_rng(trial).uniform(-0.4, 0.4, CORD_N + 1)
+        sol = least_squares(residual, q0, bounds=(-lim, lim))
+        if best is None or sol.cost < best.cost:
+            best = sol
+    links, (pos, rot) = cord_fk(which, best.x)
+    if verbose:
+        pts = _points(links)
+        print(f"route {which}: plug pos error {np.linalg.norm(pos - sp) * 1000:.2f} mm, rot error "
+              f"{np.degrees(np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(sr.T @ rot).as_rotvec())):.2f} deg, lowest "
+              f"{min(e[2] for e in pts) * 1000:.1f} mm, x {min(e[0] for e in pts):.3f}..{max(e[0] for e in pts):.3f}, "
+              f"y {min(e[1] for e in pts):.3f}..{max(e[1] for e in pts):.3f}, max |q| "
+              f"{np.degrees(np.abs(best.x).max()):.0f} deg, cost {best.cost:.4f}")
+    return best.x
+
+
+def _capsule_x(stage, path, length, radius, material):
+    cap = UsdGeom.Capsule.Define(stage, path)
+    cap.CreateAxisAttr("X")
+    cap.CreateRadiusAttr(radius)
+    cap.CreateHeightAttr(float(length))
+    UsdGeom.Xformable(cap).AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(length / 2, 0, 0))
+    UsdShade.MaterialBindingAPI.Apply(cap.GetPrim()).Bind(material)
+    UsdPhysics.CollisionAPI.Apply(cap.GetPrim())
+    return cap
+
+
+def _plug_geometry(stage, c, mats):
+    """The M-style plug in the plug frame; returns (grip colliders, nipple colliders)."""
+    sq = lambda hw: (-hw, hw)  # noqa: E731
+    nipple = [str(_box(stage, f"{c}/{name}", xs, sq(hw), sq(hw), mats["zinc"]).GetPath())
+              for name, xs, hw in (("lip", LIP_X, NIP_HW), ("groove", GROOVE_X, GROOVE_HW),
+                                   ("shank", SHANK_X, NIP_HW))]
+    for name in ("lip", "groove", "shank"):
+        kit.hide(stage, f"{c}/{name}")
+    for name, xs, r in (("lip_vis", LIP_X, NIP_HW + 0.0001), ("groove_vis", GROOVE_X, GROOVE_HW + 0.0001),
+                        ("shank_vis", SHANK_X, NIP_HW + 0.0001)):
+        kit.cylinder(stage, f"{c}/{name}", ((xs[0] + xs[1]) / 2, 0, 0), r, xs[1] - xs[0], mats["zinc"], axis="X")
+    grip = [str(_box(stage, f"{c}/hex", HEX_X, sq(HEX_HW), sq(HEX_HW), mats["zinc"]).GetPath()),
+            str(_box(stage, f"{c}/stem", STEM_X, sq(STEM_HW), sq(STEM_HW), mats["zinc"]).GetPath()),
+            str(_box(stage, f"{c}/ferrule", FERRULE_X, sq(FERRULE_HW), sq(FERRULE_HW), mats["steel"]).GetPath())]
+    for name in ("hex", "stem", "ferrule"):
+        kit.hide(stage, f"{c}/{name}")
+    _hex_prism(stage, f"{c}/hex_vis", HEX_X[0], HEX_X[1], 2 * HEX_HW, mats["zinc"])
+    kit.cylinder(stage, f"{c}/stem_vis", ((STEM_X[0] + STEM_X[1]) / 2, 0, 0), STEM_HW, STEM_X[1] - STEM_X[0],
+                 mats["zinc"], axis="X")
+    kit.cylinder(stage, f"{c}/ferrule_vis", ((FERRULE_X[0] + FERRULE_X[1]) / 2, 0, 0), FERRULE_HW,
+                 FERRULE_X[1] - FERRULE_X[0], mats["steel"], axis="X")
+    for j in range(3):
+        x = FERRULE_X[0] + 0.003 + 0.0035 * j
+        kit.cylinder(stage, f"{c}/crimp_{j}", (x, 0, 0), FERRULE_HW + 0.0002, 0.0012, mats["zinc"], axis="X")
+    return grip, nipple
+
+
+def make_hose(out_path: Path, which: str, q=None) -> None:
+    root = f"/hose_{which}"
+    stage, root_prim = kit.new_stage(out_path, root)
+    kit.articulation_root(stage, root_prim, self_collisions=False)
+    _solver(root_prim)

+def _shell(stage, path, sign, mats, label_tex=None):

+"""The Master Lock 410 Zenex padlock in the shape of the real lock, built on the box padlock model in padlock_props
+(``make_padlock``: published body and shackle dimensions, sprung shackle on a prismatic joint; ``make_prelocked``:
+the same lock as one rigid body, shut).
+
+What this adds to that model, following the 410's published outline and product photos
+(https://www.masterlock.com/business-use/product/410RED: body 1-1/2 in wide, 1-3/4 in tall, 3/4 in thick; 1/4 in
+shackle, 1-1/2 in vertical and 3/4 in horizontal clearance):
+
+- Round shackle with a semicircular bend. Collision: square-section legs up to the bend's centre and six straight
+  segments around the bend (the inside of the bend is the published 38 mm above the body), instead of the flat
+  top bar. Visual: round legs and a half-torus.
+- Rounded body: visual outline with 4 mm corner radius over the box collider; white "DANGER" label with a red band
+  on both wide faces; keyway on the bottom.
+- The short leg's collider is a cross of two 6.35 x 2.6 mm bars with low friction, so the lock can turn in a
+  square hole and hang from it as a real lock does (a square leg cannot turn in a square hole).
+
+Padlock frame as in padlock_props: origin at the body's centre, legs along z on top, short leg at +x, thickness
+along y. ``make_padlock_410`` restyles the articulated lock, ``make_prelocked_410`` the shut one-body lock.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from pxr import Gf, Sdf, Usd, UsdGeom, UsdPhysics, UsdShade, Vt
+
+from airlock_sim.usd import padlock_props as PP
+
+V = PP.PADLOCKS["ml410"]
+BEND_R = V.leg_x
+"""Shackle centre-line radius at the bend (legs' centres 26.35 mm apart)."""
+BEND_ZC = V.clear_v - (BEND_R - V.rod / 2)
+"""Bend centre above the body's top, shut (inside of the bend 38 mm above the body)."""
+CORNER_R = 0.004
+ARC_SEGMENTS = 6
+SHORT_BAR = 0.0026
+
+
+def _mat(stage, root, name, rgb):
+    path = f"{root}/Looks/{name}"
+    material = UsdShade.Material.Define(stage, path)
+    shader = UsdShade.Shader.Define(stage, f"{path}/Shader")
+    shader.CreateIdAttr("UsdPreviewSurface")
+    shader.CreateInput("diffuseColor", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Color3f).Set(Gf.Vec3f(*rgb))
+    shader.CreateInput("roughness", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Float).Set(0.4)
+    material.CreateSurfaceOutput().ConnectToSource(shader.ConnectableAPI(), "surface")
+    return material
+
+
+def _bind(prim, material):
+    UsdShade.MaterialBindingAPI.Apply(prim).Bind(material)
+
+
+def _mesh(stage, path, points, faces, material):
+    mesh = UsdGeom.Mesh.Define(stage, path)
+    mesh.CreatePointsAttr(Vt.Vec3fArray([Gf.Vec3f(*p) for p in points]))
+    mesh.CreateFaceVertexCountsAttr(Vt.IntArray([len(f) for f in faces]))
+    mesh.CreateFaceVertexIndicesAttr(Vt.IntArray([i for f in faces for i in f]))
+    mesh.CreateSubdivisionSchemeAttr("none")
+    mesh.CreateDoubleSidedAttr(True)
+    _bind(mesh.GetPrim(), material)
+    return mesh
+
+
+def _rounded_body(stage, path, material):
+    """Extruded rounded rectangle: outline in x-z (width x height), thickness along y."""
+    w, t, h = V.body
+    hx, hz, r = w / 2 - CORNER_R, h / 2 - CORNER_R, CORNER_R
+    outline = []
+    for cx, cz, a0 in ((hx, hz, 0), (-hx, hz, 90), (-hx, -hz, 180), (hx, -hz, 270)):
+        for k in range(7):
+            a = math.radians(a0 + 15 * k)
+            outline.append((cx + r * math.cos(a), cz + r * math.sin(a)))
+    n = len(outline)
+    pts = [(x, -t / 2, z) for x, z in outline] + [(x, t / 2, z) for x, z in outline]
+    faces = [[(i + 1) % n, i, n + i, n + (i + 1) % n] for i in range(n)]
+    faces.append(list(range(n)))
+    faces.append(list(range(2 * n - 1, n - 1, -1)))
+    return _mesh(stage, path, pts, faces, material)
+
+
+def _half_torus(stage, path, zc, material, seg_u=16, seg_v=10):
+    """The shackle's bend: a half torus in the x-z plane, centre (0, 0, zc), radius BEND_R, tube V.rod / 2."""
+    pts, faces = [], []
+    a = V.rod / 2
+    for i in range(seg_u + 1):
+        u = math.pi * i / seg_u
+        cx, cz = BEND_R * math.cos(u), zc + BEND_R * math.sin(u)
+        for j in range(seg_v):
+            v = 2 * math.pi * j / seg_v
+            rr = a * math.cos(v)
+            pts.append((cx + rr * math.cos(u), a * math.sin(v), cz + rr * math.sin(u)))
+    for i in range(seg_u):
+        for j in range(seg_v):
+            p = lambda ii, jj: ii * seg_v + jj % seg_v  # noqa: E731
+            faces.append([p(i, j), p(i + 1, j), p(i + 1, j + 1), p(i, j + 1)])
+    return _mesh(stage, path, pts, faces, material)
+
+
+def _cyl(stage, path, center, radius, height, material):
+    cyl = UsdGeom.Cylinder.Define(stage, path)
+    cyl.CreateAxisAttr("Z")
+    cyl.CreateRadiusAttr(radius)
+    cyl.CreateHeightAttr(height)
+    UsdGeom.Xformable(cyl).AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(*center))
+    _bind(cyl.GetPrim(), material)
+    return cyl
+
+
+def _cbox(stage, path, center, size, material, rot_y_deg=0.0, visible=False):
+    cube = UsdGeom.Cube.Define(stage, path)
+    cube.CreateSizeAttr(1.0)
+    x = UsdGeom.Xformable(cube)
+    x.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(*center))
+    if rot_y_deg:
+        x.AddRotateYOp().Set(rot_y_deg)
+    x.AddScaleOp().Set(Gf.Vec3f(*size))
+    _bind(cube.GetPrim(), material)
+    UsdPhysics.CollisionAPI.Apply(cube.GetPrim())
+    if not visible:
+        UsdGeom.Imageable(cube).MakeInvisible()
+    return cube
+
+
+def _vbox(stage, path, center, size, material):
+    cube = UsdGeom.Cube.Define(stage, path)
+    cube.CreateSizeAttr(1.0)
+    x = UsdGeom.Xformable(cube)
+    x.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(*center))
+    x.AddScaleOp().Set(Gf.Vec3f(*size))
+    _bind(cube.GetPrim(), material)
+    return cube
+
+
+def _restyle(stage, root: str, case: str, body: str, sh: str, z0: float, color_name: str) -> None:
+    """Draw the 410's outline over the box padlock under `root`: `case` is the body's box collider, `body` the prim
+    the body visuals go under, `sh` the shackle prim whose legs (at height z0 above `sh`'s origin; the body's top is
+    at z0) are replaced."""
+    steel = UsdShade.Material.Get(stage, f"{root}/Looks/steel")
+    color = UsdShade.Material.Get(stage, f"{root}/Looks/{color_name}")
+    white = _mat(stage, root, "label_white", (0.95, 0.95, 0.95))
+    red = _mat(stage, root, "label_red", (0.80, 0.08, 0.06))
+    dark = _mat(stage, root, "keyway_dark", (0.12, 0.12, 0.13))
+
+    # Body: the box stays as the collider (hidden); a rounded outline is drawn over it.
+    UsdGeom.Imageable(stage.GetPrimAtPath(case)).MakeInvisible()
+    _rounded_body(stage, f"{body}/outline", color)
+    w, t, h = V.body
+    for k, s in enumerate((-1, 1)):
+        y = s * (t / 2 + 0.0002)
+        _vbox(stage, f"{body}/label{k}", (0, y, -0.002), (0.030, 0.0004, 0.028), white)
+        _vbox(stage, f"{body}/label_band{k}", (0, s * (t / 2 + 0.0004), 0.0085), (0.030, 0.0004, 0.007), red)
+    _vbox(stage, f"{body}/keyway_ring", (0, 0, -h / 2 - 0.0003), (0.012, 0.012, 0.0006), dark)
+
+    # Shackle: replace the box legs and flat top bar.
+    for name in ("long_leg", "short_leg", "bend"):
+        stage.RemovePrim(f"{sh}/{name}")
+    rod = V.rod
+    long_lo, short_lo, bend_zc = z0 + PP.LONG_LEG_BOTTOM, z0 + PP.SHORT_LEG_BOTTOM, z0 + BEND_ZC
+    # Long leg (-x): square collider, round visual.
+    _cbox(stage, f"{sh}/long_leg", (-V.leg_x, 0, (long_lo + bend_zc) / 2), (rod, rod, bend_zc - long_lo), steel)
+    _cyl(stage, f"{sh}/long_leg_vis", (-V.leg_x, 0, (long_lo + bend_zc) / 2), rod / 2, bend_zc - long_lo, steel)
+    # Short leg (+x): a low-friction cross of two bars (turns in a square hole), round visual.
+    UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, f"{sh}/short_leg")
+    zc, length = (short_lo + bend_zc) / 2, bend_zc - short_lo
+    for name, size in (("a", (rod, SHORT_BAR, length)), ("b", (SHORT_BAR, rod, length))):
+        _cbox(stage, f"{sh}/short_leg/{name}", (V.leg_x, 0, zc), size, steel)
+    _cyl(stage, f"{sh}/short_leg/round", (V.leg_x, 0, zc), rod / 2, length, steel)
+    slick = UsdShade.Material.Define(stage, f"{root}/PhysicsMaterials/slick")
+    api = UsdPhysics.MaterialAPI.Apply(slick.GetPrim())
+    api.CreateStaticFrictionAttr(0.05)
+    api.CreateDynamicFrictionAttr(0.05)
+    slick.GetPrim().AddAppliedSchema("PhysxMaterialAPI")
+    slick.GetPrim().CreateAttribute("physxMaterial:frictionCombineMode", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Token).Set("min")
+    UsdShade.MaterialBindingAPI(stage.GetPrimAtPath(f"{sh}/short_leg")).Bind(
+        slick, UsdShade.Tokens.weakerThanDescendants, "physics")
+    # Bend: six straight square segments around the semicircle (collider), half torus (visual).
+    seg_len = 2 * (BEND_R + rod / 2) * math.tan(math.pi / (2 * ARC_SEGMENTS))
+    for i in range(ARC_SEGMENTS):
+        a = math.pi * (i + 0.5) / ARC_SEGMENTS
+        center = (BEND_R * math.cos(a), 0.0, bend_zc + BEND_R * math.sin(a))
+        _cbox(stage, f"{sh}/bend_{i}", center, (rod, rod, seg_len), steel, rot_y_deg=-math.degrees(a))
+    _half_torus(stage, f"{sh}/bend_vis", bend_zc, steel)
+
+
+def make_padlock_410(out_path: Path, variant: PP.PadlockVariant = V) -> None:
+    """The articulated lock (body and sprung shackle), in the 410's shape and `variant`'s colour."""
+    assert variant.body == V.body and variant.rod == V.rod and variant.clear_v == V.clear_v
+    PP.make_padlock(out_path, variant)
+    stage = Usd.Stage.Open(str(out_path))
+    _restyle(stage, "/padlock", "/padlock/body/case", "/padlock/body", "/padlock/shackle", 0.0, variant.color)
+    stage.GetRootLayer().Save()
+
+
+def make_prelocked_410(out_path: Path) -> None:
+    """The shut lock as one rigid body (padlock_props.make_prelocked, with its danger tag), in the 410's shape."""
+    v = PP.PRELOCKED
+    assert v.body == V.body and v.rod == V.rod and v.clear_v == V.clear_v
+    PP.make_prelocked(out_path)
+    stage = Usd.Stage.Open(str(out_path))
+    UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, "/prelocked/body")
+    _restyle(stage, "/prelocked", "/prelocked/case", "/prelocked/body", "/prelocked/shackle", v.body_top, v.color)
+    stage.GetRootLayer().Save()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    make_padlock_410(Path(sys.argv[1]))

+"""Padlock through a hasp (geometry shared with the group hasp): instruction and published seeds, with no simulator imports.
+
+Two disconnect-switch boxes stand side by side on a panel, each with a colour tag and a hasp: a
+horizontal plate sticking out toward the robot with a hole of 8-10 mm near its free end. One switch is
+already locked (a closed padlock hangs from its hasp, with a red danger tag); the instruction names
+the other by colour. An open lockout padlock stands on a pedestal between the two switches.
+The padlock and the lock points follow real parts, in vendor variants that change between seeds
+(PADLOCK_NAMES, LOCK_POINT_NAMES; dimensions in airlock_sim/usd/padlock_props.py).
+Arm A picks it up and threads the shackle's short leg down through the named hasp's slot; arm B
+(the right arm) pushes the shackle shut until it snaps. The trial is held once the robot lets go and
+the lock survives a 10 N downward tug.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+TASK_NAME = "padlock-hasp"
+EPISODE_SECONDS = 90.0
+NUM_SEEDS = 20
+TAG_COLORS = ("blue", "yellow")
+PANEL_FACE_X = 0.31
+"""World x of the switch boxes' front faces (the hasps stick out toward the robot, along -x)."""
+SWITCH_Y = (-0.12, 0.03)
+"""World y of the two switch positions (slot 0 past the midline, slot 1 toward arm A)."""
+HASP_Z = 0.24
+"""World z of the hasp tabs' mid-plane."""
+PADLOCK_NAMES = ("ml410", "a1105", "abus7440")
+"""Master Lock 410 Zenex, American Lock A1105 (short shackle), ABUS 74/40 (thicker shackle)."""
+LOCK_POINT_NAMES = ("handle_tab", "hasp420")
+"""A switch handle's lockout tab (10.3 mm hole) and a Master Lock 420 hasp (8 mm hole)."""
+PEDESTAL_XY = (0.27, -0.045)
+"""The open padlock's pedestal, midway between the two hasps, so carrying it to either one never
+passes the pre-applied padlock.
+Arm A grips the padlock's body level from behind, which the YAM can hold only at x >= 0.2 and grasp
+height about 0.13-0.17; the panel, pedestal and hasp height keep the
+grasp there."""
+
+
+def instruction(color: str) -> str:
+    return (
+        f"Lock out the switch with the {color} tag: put the padlock's shackle through its hasp and snap it shut. "
+        "Do not touch the switch that is already locked."
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PadlockSeed:
+    seed: int
+    named_color: str
+    named_slot: int
+    """The named switch's position; the other switch carries the pre-applied lock."""
+    padlock: str
+    lock_point: str
+    """Both switches carry the same kind of lock point."""
+
+    @property
+    def slot_colors(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
+        other = TAG_COLORS[1 - TAG_COLORS.index(self.named_color)]
+        return (self.named_color, other) if self.named_slot == 0 else (other, self.named_color)
+
+    @property
+    def instruction(self) -> str:
+        return instruction(self.named_color)
+
+
+def make_seed(seed: int) -> PadlockSeed:
+    """Named colour and named slot each split 10/10 across the 20 seeds, in all four combinations. The
+    padlock cycles through its three variants (7/7/6) and the lock points split 10/10, both crossed with
+    colour and slot.
+
+    The padlock always starts on the one pedestal (a second spot would need a second pedestal in the
+    scene, and any spot near the first blocks the fingers' way to it).
+    """
+    assert 0 <= seed < NUM_SEEDS, f"seed must be in [0, {NUM_SEEDS})"
+    slot = (seed // 2) % 2 if seed < 16 else (seed // 2 + 1) % 2
+    return PadlockSeed(seed, TAG_COLORS[seed % 2], slot, PADLOCK_NAMES[seed % 3], LOCK_POINT_NAMES[(seed // 2 + seed // 4) % 2])

+"""Generate the padlock props as USD: the switch panel, the lockout plates (one file per real lock
+point), the lockout padlocks (one file per real padlock), the pre-applied padlock on the other switch,
+and the pedestal the open padlock starts on, with a parking shelf under the desk.
+
+The props follow real parts. Every variant is spawned in every scene; each seed
+uses one padlock and one lock point, and the task parks the others out of sight.
+
+Panel frame: origin on the desk at the switch boxes' front face (world x = PANEL_FACE_X, world y and z
+unchanged); +x into the panel.
+
+Lock point frame: origin where the plate meets the switch face, on the plate's mid-plane; the plate
+sticks out toward the robot (-x) with a hole near its free end, so a shackle leg drops through the
+hole while the other leg stays outside the plate's end. Lock points are kinematic bodies the task
+places on the switches.
+
+Padlock frame: origin at the body's centre; the shackle's legs stand on the body's top, the short leg
+at +x and the long leg at -x, and the body's thickness is along y for the gripper's fingers. The
+padlock is an articulation: the shackle slides on a prismatic joint along z, from 0 (shut) to
+OPEN_TRAVEL (open, short leg clear of the body). The task supplies the spring and the latch.
+
+Usage: python make_padlock_props.py <out dir>
+"""
+
+import sys
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from pxr import Gf, Sdf, Usd, UsdGeom, UsdPhysics, UsdShade
+
+from airlock_sim.usd.padlock_layout import HASP_Z, LOCK_POINT_NAMES, PADLOCK_NAMES, PEDESTAL_XY, SWITCH_Y, TAG_COLORS
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PadlockVariant:
+    """A real lockout padlock, from its published dimensions. Collision shapes are
+    boxes: a round rod of diameter d is a square rod of side d, which keeps its clearance in a hole."""
+
+    name: str
+    source: str
+    body: tuple[float, float, float]
+    """Width (x, across the legs), thickness (y, the gripper's faces) and height (z)."""
+    rod: float
+    clear_h: float
+    """Horizontal shackle clearance: the gap between the legs."""
+    clear_v: float
+    """Vertical shackle clearance: body top to the inside of the bend, shut."""
+    mass: float
+    color: str
+
+    @property
+    def body_top(self) -> float:
+        return self.body[2] / 2
+
+    @property
+    def leg_x(self) -> float:
+        return (self.clear_h + self.rod) / 2
+
+    @property
+    def bend_z(self) -> float:
+        """Bend centre above the body's top, shut."""
+        return self.clear_v + self.rod / 2
+
+    @property
+    def grasp_in_lock(self) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
+        """Arm A's grasp point (between the fingertips): the body's lower rear corner."""
+        return (-self.body[0] / 2 + GRASP_DEPTH, 0.0, -self.body[2] / 2 + GRASP_DEPTH)
+
+    def short_tip(self, travel: float) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
+        """The short leg's lower tip in the padlock frame, with the shackle out by `travel`."""
+        return (self.leg_x, 0.0, self.body_top + SHORT_LEG_BOTTOM + travel)
+
+    def bend_bottom(self, travel: float) -> float:
+        return self.body_top + self.bend_z - self.rod / 2 + travel
+
+    def bend_top(self, travel: float) -> float:
+        return self.body_top + self.bend_z + self.rod / 2 + travel
+
+
+PADLOCKS = {
+    v.name: v
+    for v in (
+        PadlockVariant("ml410", "Master Lock 410 Zenex", (0.038, 0.019, 0.044), 0.00635, 0.020, 0.038, 0.10,
+                       "lock_purple"),
+        PadlockVariant("a1105", "American Lock A1105", (0.038, 0.019, 0.048), 0.00635, 0.020, 0.025, 0.11,
+                       "lock_blue"),
+        PadlockVariant("abus7440", "ABUS 74/40", (0.040, 0.020, 0.045), 0.00675, 0.019, 0.038, 0.088,
+                       "lock_orange"),
+    )
+}
+assert tuple(PADLOCKS) == PADLOCK_NAMES
+PRELOCKED = PadlockVariant("ml410_yellow", "Master Lock 410 Zenex, yellow (410YLW)", (0.038, 0.019, 0.044), 0.00635, 0.020, 0.038,
+                           0.10, "lock_yellow")
+"""Another worker's lock on the other switch."""
+PRELOCKED_DAMPING = 3.0
+SHORT_LEG_BOTTOM = -0.004
+"""The short leg's tip inside the shut body (its latch notch)."""
+OPEN_TRAVEL = 0.016
+"""How far the shackle pops up. Not published for any lockout lock; an assumption to measure on bought
+locks: enough that the short leg clears the body by 12 mm, room for a lockout plate to slide under it."""
+LONG_LEG_BOTTOM = -(OPEN_TRAVEL + 0.008)
+"""The long leg stays 8 mm inside the body when open (it is the pivot of a real lock)."""
+SHACKLE_MASS = 0.02
+GRASP_DEPTH = 0.010
+"""Arm A holds the body by its lower rear corner, the grasp point this far in from the rear and bottom
+faces. Its wrist camera then clears both the body and the open shackle (a real-size body is short)."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LockPointVariant:
+    """A real lockout point: a steel plate sticking out toward the robot with a hole near its end.
+    The hole is a square of side `hole` (see PadlockVariant)."""
+
+    name: str
+    source: str
+    tab_len: float
+    tab_width: float
+    tab_t: float
+    hole: float
+    end_strip: float
+    """Steel between the hole and the plate's free end."""
+
+    @property
+    def hole_x(self) -> float:
+        """Hole centre in the lock point (and panel) frame."""
+        return -self.tab_len + self.end_strip + self.hole / 2
+
+
+LOCK_POINTS = {
+    v.name: v
+    for v in (
+        # Square D general-duty switch handles take a 3/8" (9.5 mm) shackle at most; hole and plate
+        # thickness are not published (inferred: 10.3 mm hole, 3 mm plate).
+        LockPointVariant("handle_tab", "switch-handle lockout tab (Square D GD style)", 0.040, 0.025, 0.003, 0.0103,
+                         0.004),
+        # Master Lock 420 hasp: fits shackles up to 7 mm (hole ~8 mm, inferred); two overlapping jaw
+        # plates of unpublished thickness (~1.5 mm each, inferred) modelled as one 3.5 mm plate held still
+        # (a real hasp hangs from the switch handle).
+        LockPointVariant("hasp420", "Master Lock 420 lockout hasp", 0.040, 0.030, 0.0035, 0.008, 0.004),
+    )
+}
+assert tuple(LOCK_POINTS) == LOCK_POINT_NAMES
+
+CABINET = (0.10, 0.26, 0.30)
+CABINET_Y = (min(SWITCH_Y) + max(SWITCH_Y)) / 2
+PEDESTAL_TOP = 0.146
+"""Height of the pedestal's top (the padlock's bottom face rests on it): arm A's level grasp at the
+body's lower rear corner is then in the YAM's band (grasp height about 0.13-0.17)."""
+PARK_Z = -0.30
+"""The parking shelf under the desk, for the padlocks and plates a seed does not use."""
+PARK_X = 0.30
+PARK_SPACING_Y = 0.12
+
+COLORS = {
+    "cabinet": (0.55, 0.58, 0.55),
+    "switch": (0.30, 0.31, 0.33),
+    "steel": (0.72, 0.74, 0.77),
+    "brass": (0.80, 0.62, 0.20),
+    "lock_red": (0.80, 0.10, 0.08),
+    "lock_yellow": (0.95, 0.72, 0.05),
+    "lock_purple": (0.45, 0.20, 0.60),
+    "lock_blue": (0.15, 0.35, 0.75),
+    "lock_orange": (0.90, 0.45, 0.08),
+    "danger": (0.90, 0.10, 0.10),
+    "white": (0.95, 0.95, 0.95),
+    "dark": (0.12, 0.12, 0.13),
+    "stand": (0.40, 0.40, 0.42),
+    "blue": (0.10, 0.30, 0.85),
+    "yellow": (0.95, 0.78, 0.10),
+}
+
+
+def _material(stage, root, name):
+    path = f"{root}/Looks/{name}"
+    material = UsdShade.Material.Define(stage, path)
+    shader = UsdShade.Shader.Define(stage, f"{path}/Shader")
+    shader.CreateIdAttr("UsdPreviewSurface")
+    shader.CreateInput("diffuseColor", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Color3f).Set(Gf.Vec3f(*COLORS[name]))
+    shader.CreateInput("roughness", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Float).Set(0.5)
+    material.CreateSurfaceOutput().ConnectToSource(shader.ConnectableAPI(), "surface")
+    return material
+
+
+def _box(stage, path, center, size, material, collide=True):
+    cube = UsdGeom.Cube.Define(stage, path)
+    cube.CreateSizeAttr(1.0)
+    xform = UsdGeom.Xformable(cube)
+    xform.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(*center))
+    xform.AddScaleOp().Set(Gf.Vec3f(*size))
+    UsdShade.MaterialBindingAPI.Apply(cube.GetPrim()).Bind(material)
+    if collide:
+        UsdPhysics.CollisionAPI.Apply(cube.GetPrim())
+    return cube
+
+
+def _friction(stage, root, paths):
+    friction = UsdShade.Material.Define(stage, f"{root}/PhysicsMaterials/rubber")
+    api = UsdPhysics.MaterialAPI.Apply(friction.GetPrim())
+    api.CreateStaticFrictionAttr(1.5)
+    api.CreateDynamicFrictionAttr(1.2)
+    friction.GetPrim().AddAppliedSchema("PhysxMaterialAPI")
+    friction.GetPrim().CreateAttribute("physxMaterial:frictionCombineMode", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Token).Set("max")
+    for path in paths:
+        UsdShade.MaterialBindingAPI(stage.GetPrimAtPath(path)).Bind(friction, UsdShade.Tokens.weakerThanDescendants,
+                                                                   "physics")
+
+
+def _new_stage(out_path, root):
+    stage = Usd.Stage.CreateNew(str(out_path))
+    UsdGeom.SetStageUpAxis(stage, UsdGeom.Tokens.z)
+    UsdGeom.SetStageMetersPerUnit(stage, 1.0)
+    prim = UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, root).GetPrim()
+    stage.SetDefaultPrim(prim)
+    return stage, prim
+
+
+def _shackle(stage, path, mats, v: PadlockVariant, z0=0.0):
+    """The U-shaped shackle in a frame at the body's top centre, shifted up by z0."""
+    long_len = v.bend_z - LONG_LEG_BOTTOM
+    short_len = v.bend_z - SHORT_LEG_BOTTOM
+    rod = v.rod
+    _box(stage, f"{path}/long_leg", (-v.leg_x, 0, z0 + LONG_LEG_BOTTOM + long_len / 2), (rod, rod, long_len),
+         mats["steel"])
+    _box(stage, f"{path}/short_leg", (v.leg_x, 0, z0 + SHORT_LEG_BOTTOM + short_len / 2), (rod, rod, short_len),
+         mats["steel"])
+    _box(stage, f"{path}/bend", (0, 0, z0 + v.bend_z), (2 * v.leg_x + rod, rod, rod), mats["steel"])
+
+
+def make_panel(out_path: Path) -> None:
+    """The cabinet and the two switch faces with their tags; the lockout plates are separate bodies."""
+    stage, _ = _new_stage(out_path, "/panel")
+    root = "/panel"
+    mats = {name: _material(stage, root, name) for name in COLORS}
+    _box(stage, f"{root}/cabinet", (CABINET[0] / 2, CABINET_Y, CABINET[2] / 2), CABINET, mats["cabinet"])
+    for slot, y in enumerate(SWITCH_Y):
+        sw = f"{root}/switch_{slot}"
+        UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, sw)
+        _box(stage, f"{sw}/plate", (-0.002, y, HASP_Z), (0.004, 0.10, 0.11), mats["switch"], collide=False)
+        # Operating handle, down (off), on the face beside the lock point: visual only.
+        _box(stage, f"{sw}/handle", (-0.015, y + 0.038, HASP_Z - 0.03), (0.03, 0.014, 0.04), mats["dark"], collide=False)
+        for color in TAG_COLORS:
+            _box(stage, f"{sw}/tag_{color}", (-0.005, y, HASP_Z + 0.035), (0.003, 0.06, 0.025), mats[color], collide=False)
+        UsdGeom.Imageable(stage.GetPrimAtPath(f"{sw}/tag_{TAG_COLORS[1 - slot]}")).MakeInvisible()
+    stage.GetRootLayer().Save()
+    print(f"wrote {out_path}")
+
+
+def make_lock_point(out_path: Path, v: LockPointVariant) -> None:
+    """One lockout plate, built around its hole: the root part, two side bars and the end strip."""
+    stage, root_prim = _new_stage(out_path, "/lock_point")
+    root = "/lock_point"
+    UsdPhysics.RigidBodyAPI.Apply(root_prim).CreateKinematicEnabledAttr(True)
+    mats = {name: _material(stage, root, name) for name in ("steel",)}
+    root_len = v.tab_len - v.end_strip - v.hole
+    side_w = (v.tab_width - v.hole) / 2
+    _box(stage, f"{root}/root", (-root_len / 2, 0, 0), (root_len, v.tab_width, v.tab_t), mats["steel"])
+    for k, sign in enumerate((-1, 1)):
+        _box(stage, f"{root}/side{k}", (v.hole_x, sign * (v.hole + side_w) / 2, 0), (v.hole, side_w, v.tab_t),
+             mats["steel"])
+    _box(stage, f"{root}/end", (-v.tab_len + v.end_strip / 2, 0, 0), (v.end_strip, v.tab_width, v.tab_t),
+         mats["steel"])
+    stage.GetRootLayer().Save()
+    print(f"wrote {out_path}")
+
+
+def make_padlock(out_path: Path, v: PadlockVariant) -> None:
+    stage, root_prim = _new_stage(out_path, "/padlock")
+    root = "/padlock"
+    UsdPhysics.ArticulationRootAPI.Apply(root_prim)
+    root_prim.AddAppliedSchema("PhysxArticulationAPI")
+    root_prim.CreateAttribute("physxArticulation:enabledSelfCollisions", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Bool).Set(False)
+    mats = {name: _material(stage, root, name) for name in (v.color, "steel", "dark")}
+    body = UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, f"{root}/body")
+    UsdPhysics.RigidBodyAPI.Apply(body.GetPrim())
+    UsdPhysics.MassAPI.Apply(body.GetPrim()).CreateMassAttr(v.mass - SHACKLE_MASS)
+    _box(stage, f"{root}/body/case", (0, 0, 0), v.body, mats[v.color])
+    _box(stage, f"{root}/body/keyway", (0, 0, -v.body[2] / 2 - 0.0005), (0.008, 0.004, 0.001), mats["dark"],
+         collide=False)
+    _friction(stage, root, [f"{root}/body/case"])
+    shackle = UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, f"{root}/shackle")
+    shackle.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(0, 0, v.body_top))
+    UsdPhysics.RigidBodyAPI.Apply(shackle.GetPrim())
+    UsdPhysics.MassAPI.Apply(shackle.GetPrim()).CreateMassAttr(SHACKLE_MASS)
+    _shackle(stage, f"{root}/shackle", mats, v)
+    joint = UsdPhysics.PrismaticJoint.Define(stage, f"{root}/joints/shackle_joint")
+    joint.CreateBody0Rel().SetTargets([body.GetPath()])
+    joint.CreateBody1Rel().SetTargets([shackle.GetPath()])
+    joint.CreateAxisAttr("Z")
+    joint.CreateLocalPos0Attr(Gf.Vec3f(0, 0, v.body_top))
+    joint.CreateLocalPos1Attr(Gf.Vec3f(0, 0, 0))
+    joint.CreateLowerLimitAttr(0.0)
+    joint.CreateUpperLimitAttr(OPEN_TRAVEL)
+    UsdPhysics.DriveAPI.Apply(joint.GetPrim(), "linear")
+    stage.GetRootLayer().Save()
+    print(f"wrote {out_path}")
+
+
+def make_prelocked(out_path: Path) -> None:
+    """The padlock already on the other switch: one rigid body, shackle shut, with a red danger tag."""
+    v = PRELOCKED
+    stage, root_prim = _new_stage(out_path, "/prelocked")
+    root = "/prelocked"
+    UsdPhysics.RigidBodyAPI.Apply(root_prim)
+    UsdPhysics.MassAPI.Apply(root_prim).CreateMassAttr(v.mass)
+    # Stands in for the friction where a real lock hangs, which stops its swing within a few seconds;
+    # PhysX's contact alone lets a hanging body rattle on indefinitely.
+    root_prim.AddAppliedSchema("PhysxRigidBodyAPI")
+    root_prim.CreateAttribute("physxRigidBody:angularDamping", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Float).Set(PRELOCKED_DAMPING)
+    root_prim.CreateAttribute("physxRigidBody:linearDamping", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Float).Set(PRELOCKED_DAMPING)
+    mats = {name: _material(stage, root, name) for name in (v.color, "steel", "danger", "white")}
+    _box(stage, f"{root}/case", (0, 0, 0), v.body, mats[v.color])
+    UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, f"{root}/shackle")
+    _shackle(stage, f"{root}/shackle", mats, v, z0=v.body_top)
+    _box(stage, f"{root}/tag", (0, 0, -v.body[2] / 2 - 0.03), (0.035, 0.002, 0.05), mats["danger"], collide=False)
+    _box(stage, f"{root}/tag_band", (0, -0.0012, -v.body[2] / 2 - 0.022), (0.03, 0.001, 0.008), mats["white"],
+         collide=False)
+    stage.GetRootLayer().Save()
+    print(f"wrote {out_path}")
+
+
+def make_pedestals(out_path: Path) -> None:
+    """The pedestal (world frame): a column under the padlock body, thinner than any body so the
+    fingertips pass beside it when they grip the body's lower rear corner. Also the parking shelf."""
+    stage, _ = _new_stage(out_path, "/pedestal")
+    root = "/pedestal"
+    mats = {name: _material(stage, root, name) for name in ("stand",)}
+    x, y = PEDESTAL_XY
+    _box(stage, f"{root}/foot", (x, y, 0.005), (0.06, 0.05, 0.01), mats["stand"])
+    _box(stage, f"{root}/column", (x, y, PEDESTAL_TOP / 2), (0.030, 0.009, PEDESTAL_TOP), mats["stand"])
+    _box(stage, f"{root}/park_shelf", (PARK_X, 0.0, PARK_Z - 0.005), (0.10, 0.60, 0.01), mats["stand"])
+    stage.GetRootLayer().Save()
+    print(f"wrote {out_path}")
+
+
+def park_pos(index: int) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
+    """A spot on the parking shelf (world frame, the shelf's top surface)."""
+    return (PARK_X, (index - 2) * PARK_SPACING_Y, PARK_Z)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    out_dir = Path(sys.argv[1])
+    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    make_panel(out_dir / "panel.usda")
+    for variant in LOCK_POINTS.values():
+        make_lock_point(out_dir / f"lock_point_{variant.name}.usda", variant)
+    for variant in PADLOCKS.values():
+        make_padlock(out_dir / f"padlock_{variant.name}.usda", variant)
+    make_prelocked(out_dir / "prelocked.usda")
+    make_pedestals(out_dir / "pedestal.usda")

+"""USD helpers for the prop generator (twistlock_props.py). Collision shapes are boxes; cylinders are visual only."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pxr import Gf, Sdf, Usd, UsdGeom, UsdPhysics, UsdShade
+
+
+COLORS = {
+    "red": (0.80, 0.06, 0.05),
+    "dark_red": (0.55, 0.04, 0.03),
+    "blue": (0.10, 0.30, 0.85),
+    "green": (0.10, 0.62, 0.20),
+    "yellow": (0.95, 0.78, 0.10),
+    "white": (0.95, 0.95, 0.95),
+    "orange": (0.92, 0.45, 0.08),
+    "purple": (0.45, 0.20, 0.60),
+    "black": (0.05, 0.05, 0.05),
+    "dark": (0.12, 0.12, 0.13),
+    "grey": (0.55, 0.57, 0.60),
+    "light_grey": (0.78, 0.79, 0.80),
+    "enclosure": (0.80, 0.80, 0.76),
+    "steel": (0.72, 0.74, 0.77),
+    "copper": (0.80, 0.45, 0.20),
+    "stand": (0.40, 0.40, 0.42),
+}
+
+
+def new_stage(out_path, root: str):
+    stage = Usd.Stage.CreateNew(str(out_path))
+    UsdGeom.SetStageUpAxis(stage, UsdGeom.Tokens.z)
+    UsdGeom.SetStageMetersPerUnit(stage, 1.0)
+    prim = UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, root).GetPrim()
+    stage.SetDefaultPrim(prim)
+    return stage, prim
+
+
+def materials(stage, root: str, names=None) -> dict:
+    out = {}
+    for name in names or COLORS:
+        path = f"{root}/Looks/{name}"
+        material = UsdShade.Material.Define(stage, path)
+        shader = UsdShade.Shader.Define(stage, f"{path}/Shader")
+        shader.CreateIdAttr("UsdPreviewSurface")
+        shader.CreateInput("diffuseColor", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Color3f).Set(Gf.Vec3f(*COLORS[name]))
+        shader.CreateInput("roughness", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Float).Set(0.5)
+        material.CreateSurfaceOutput().ConnectToSource(shader.ConnectableAPI(), "surface")
+        out[name] = material
+    return out
+
+
+def box(stage, path, center, size, material, collide=True):
+    cube = UsdGeom.Cube.Define(stage, path)
+    cube.CreateSizeAttr(1.0)
+    xform = UsdGeom.Xformable(cube)
+    xform.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(*center))
+    xform.AddScaleOp().Set(Gf.Vec3f(*size))
+    UsdShade.MaterialBindingAPI.Apply(cube.GetPrim()).Bind(material)
+    if collide:
+        UsdPhysics.CollisionAPI.Apply(cube.GetPrim())
+    return cube
+
+
+def cylinder(stage, path, center, radius, height, material, axis="Z"):
+    """A visual-only cylinder (collision stays on boxes)."""
+    cyl = UsdGeom.Cylinder.Define(stage, path)
+    cyl.CreateRadiusAttr(radius)
+    cyl.CreateHeightAttr(height)
+    cyl.CreateAxisAttr(axis)
+    UsdGeom.Xformable(cyl).AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(*center))
+    UsdShade.MaterialBindingAPI.Apply(cyl.GetPrim()).Bind(material)
+    return cyl
+
+
+def rigid_body(stage, path, translate, mass, kinematic=False):
+    xform = UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, path)
+    xform.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(*translate))
+    rb = UsdPhysics.RigidBodyAPI.Apply(xform.GetPrim())
+    if kinematic:
+        rb.CreateKinematicEnabledAttr(True)
+    UsdPhysics.MassAPI.Apply(xform.GetPrim()).CreateMassAttr(mass)
+    return xform
+
+
+def articulation_root(stage, root_prim, self_collisions=False):
+    UsdPhysics.ArticulationRootAPI.Apply(root_prim)
+    root_prim.AddAppliedSchema("PhysxArticulationAPI")
+    root_prim.CreateAttribute("physxArticulation:enabledSelfCollisions", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Bool).Set(self_collisions)
+
+
+def fix_to_world(stage, root: str, body_path) -> None:
+    fixed = UsdPhysics.FixedJoint.Define(stage, f"{root}/joints/world_fixed")
+    fixed.CreateBody1Rel().SetTargets([Sdf.Path(str(body_path))])
+
+
+def friction(stage, root, paths, static=1.0, dynamic=0.8, name="rubber", combine="max"):
+    mat = UsdShade.Material.Define(stage, f"{root}/PhysicsMaterials/{name}")
+    api = UsdPhysics.MaterialAPI.Apply(mat.GetPrim())
+    api.CreateStaticFrictionAttr(static)
+    api.CreateDynamicFrictionAttr(dynamic)
+    mat.GetPrim().AddAppliedSchema("PhysxMaterialAPI")
+    mat.GetPrim().CreateAttribute("physxMaterial:frictionCombineMode", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Token).Set(combine)
+    for path in paths:
+        UsdShade.MaterialBindingAPI(stage.GetPrimAtPath(path)).Bind(mat, UsdShade.Tokens.weakerThanDescendants,
+                                                                    "physics")
+
+
+def revolute(stage, path, body0, body1, axis, pos0, lower_deg, upper_deg, rot0=None):
+    joint = UsdPhysics.RevoluteJoint.Define(stage, path)
+    joint.CreateBody0Rel().SetTargets([Sdf.Path(str(body0))])
+    joint.CreateBody1Rel().SetTargets([Sdf.Path(str(body1))])
+    joint.CreateAxisAttr(axis)
+    joint.CreateLocalPos0Attr(Gf.Vec3f(*pos0))
+    joint.CreateLocalPos1Attr(Gf.Vec3f(0, 0, 0))
+    if rot0 is not None:
+        joint.CreateLocalRot0Attr(Gf.Quatf(*rot0))
+        joint.CreateLocalRot1Attr(Gf.Quatf(*rot0))
+    joint.CreateLowerLimitAttr(lower_deg)
+    joint.CreateUpperLimitAttr(upper_deg)
+    UsdPhysics.DriveAPI.Apply(joint.GetPrim(), "angular")
+    return joint
+
+
+def prismatic(stage, path, body0, body1, axis, pos0, lower, upper):
+    joint = UsdPhysics.PrismaticJoint.Define(stage, path)
+    joint.CreateBody0Rel().SetTargets([Sdf.Path(str(body0))])
+    joint.CreateBody1Rel().SetTargets([Sdf.Path(str(body1))])
+    joint.CreateAxisAttr(axis)
+    joint.CreateLocalPos0Attr(Gf.Vec3f(*pos0))
+    joint.CreateLocalPos1Attr(Gf.Vec3f(0, 0, 0))
+    joint.CreateLowerLimitAttr(lower)
+    joint.CreateUpperLimitAttr(upper)
+    UsdPhysics.DriveAPI.Apply(joint.GetPrim(), "linear")
+    return joint
+
+
+def hide(stage, path) -> None:
+    UsdGeom.Imageable(stage.GetPrimAtPath(path)).MakeInvisible()
